summary.title: EyeArt 2.1.0: diabetic retinopathy detection in primary care

claim.text: Can our primary-care clinics use EyeArt 2.1.0 to screen adults with diabetes and no previous diagnosis of more than mild diabetic retinopathy, and does the evidence behind a sensitivity of at least 85 percent apply to that use?

exclusions: previously diagnosed with more than mild diabetic retinopathy

claimText: Can our primary-care clinics use EyeArt 2.1.0 to screen adults with diabetes and no previous diagnosis of more than mild diabetic retinopathy, and does the evidence behind a sensitivity of at least 85 percent apply to that use?

claims.text: Can our primary-care clinics use EyeArt 2.1.0 to screen adults with diabetes and no previous diagnosis of more than mild diabetic retinopathy, and does the evidence behind a sensitivity of at least 85 percent apply to that use?

exclusions: previously diagnosed with more than mild diabetic retinopathy

claims.text: In the population of the pivotal study (adults aged 22 and older with diabetes, excluding anyone previously diagnosed with more than mild diabetic retinopathy, with a history of macular edema or retinal vascular occlusion, with ocular injections, retinal laser treatment or intraocular surgery other than uncomplicated cataract surgery, with persistent visual impairment, who cannot be imaged or dilated, who are enrolled in another interventional study, or whose condition could confound the results), EyeArt 2.1.0 detects more than mild diabetic retinopathy as an aid to the clinician in primary care and eye care settings, using the Canon CR-2 AF or CR-2 Plus AF camera.

exclusions: previously diagnosed with more than mild diabetic retinopathy
Persistent visual impairment in one or both eyes;
History of macular edema or retinal vascular (vein or artery) occlusion;
History of ocular injections, laser treatment of the retina, or intraocular surgery other than cataract surgery without complications;
Subject is contraindicated for fundus photography (for example, has light sensitivity);
Subject has contraindications for mydriatic medications or is unwilling or unable to dilate;
Subject is currently enrolled in an interventional study of an investigational device or drug; or

Subject has a condition or is in a situation which in the opinion of the Investigator, might confound study results, may interfere significantly with the subject's participation in the study, or may result in ungradable clinical reference standard photographs.

SELECT
  c.case_id,
  c.intended_purpose,
  c.intended_setting,
  CAST(c.intended_min_age AS INT)               AS intended_min_age,
  s.product_name,
  vc.claim_id,
  vc.claimed_version,
  CAST(vc.claimed_min_age_years AS INT)         AS claimed_min_age_years,
  vc.claimed_setting,
  vc.claimed_purpose,
  k.k_number,
  k.decision_date,
  k.clearance_type,
  u.udi_versions,
  st.confirmed_studies,
  st.study_min_age_years,
  rq.requirement_count,
  rq.required_min_age,
  CASE WHEN instr(concat('|', coalesce(u.udi_versions, ''), '|'), concat('|', vc.claimed_version, '|')) > 0
       THEN 'LISTED' ELSE 'NOT_LISTED' END      AS version_in_device_record,
  CASE WHEN st.study_min_age_years IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN'
       WHEN CAST(vc.claimed_min_age_years AS DOUBLE) < st.study_min_age_years THEN 'CLAIM_BELOW_STUDY_MINIMUM'
       ELSE 'WITHIN_STUDY' END                  AS claim_age_vs_study,
  CASE WHEN st.study_min_age_years IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN'
       WHEN CAST(c.intended_min_age AS DOUBLE) >= st.study_min_age_years THEN 'COVERED_BY_STUDY'
       ELSE 'NOT_COVERED_BY_STUDY' END          AS case_age_vs_study
FROM hospital.cases c
JOIN hospital.submissions s ON s.submission_id = c.submission_id
JOIN sk_vendor.vendor_claims vc ON vc.packet_id = s.packet_id
JOIN sk_registry.fda_510k k ON k.k_number = s.regulator_submission_cited
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT submission_number,
         concat_ws('|', sort_array(collect_set(version_or_model_number))) AS udi_versions
  FROM sk_registry.fda_udi
  GROUP BY submission_number
) u ON u.submission_number = k.k_number
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT l.case_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT t.nct_id)                           AS confirmed_studies,
         MIN(CAST(t.minimum_age_years AS DOUBLE))           AS study_min_age_years
  FROM hospital.evidence_links l
  JOIN sk_registry.ctgov_studies t ON t.nct_id = l.right_id
  WHERE l.link_class = 'CONFIRMED' AND l.right_type = 'ctgov_study'
  GROUP BY l.case_id
) st ON st.case_id = c.case_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT applies_to_purpose,
         COUNT(*)                                                                                    AS requirement_count,
         MAX(CASE WHEN dimension = 'population_min_age' THEN CAST(required_value AS INT) END)        AS required_min_age
  FROM hospital.requirements
  GROUP BY applies_to_purpose
) rq ON rq.applies_to_purpose = c.intended_purpose
WHERE c.case_id = 'CASE-2026-014'
ORDER BY c.case_id, vc.claim_id
